guide.title: ANQR User Guide
guide.subtitle: Complete guide to using ANQR for creating QR codes
guide.gettingStartedText: ANQR is a browser-based QR code generator that runs entirely in your browser. No account is required, and your data stays on your device.
guide.interfaceLevels: The interface has three interface levels: Basic, Advanced, and Professional. Select your level using the tabs in the header. Each level unlocks additional features while keeping the interface focused on what you need.
guide.basicLevel: Basic: Simple QR code creation with plain text/URL content and image overlay.
guide.advancedLevel: Advanced: QR encoding options, rendering styles, animation, output formats, and extended content types.
guide.professionalLevel: Professional: Watermarks, metadata, sharing, safety analysis, and enterprise features.
guide.quickStartIntro: To create your first QR code:
guide.step1: Select a content type (URL, text, WiFi, etc.) from the Content Type dropdown.
guide.step2: Enter your data in the provided fields.
guide.step3: Optionally customize colors, styles, and add an overlay image.
guide.step4: Click Export to download your QR code as PNG, GIF, WebP, or SVG.
guide.payloadSectionText: The Payload section is where you enter the data that will be encoded in your QR code. ANQR supports many content types including URLs, plain text, phone numbers, email addresses, SMS messages, WiFi credentials, contact cards (vCard), calendar events, and geographic locations.
guide.overlaySectionText: Add images to your QR codes while maintaining scanability. ANQR uses advanced dithering algorithms to blend your image with the QR pattern. You can adjust intensity, use different color modes, and preserve critical QR patterns for reliable scanning.
guide.qrEncodingSectionText: Control the technical aspects of your QR code. Error correction level determines how much damage the code can sustain while remaining scanable. Higher levels (Q, H) allow for more image overlay but result in larger codes.
guide.renderingSectionText: Customize the visual appearance of your QR code. Change foreground and background colors, module shapes (squares, dots, rounded), and apply gradients. The finder pattern style can be customized separately.
guide.animationSectionText: Create animated QR codes with various patterns. Set the animation speed, enable looping, and export as GIF. Animated overlays are also supported.
guide.outputSectionText: Configure the export settings including format (PNG, SVG, GIF, WebP), dimensions, filename, and DPI for print quality.
guide.watermarkSectionText: Add text watermarks to your QR codes. Customize position, opacity, font size, and color. Useful for branding or attribution.
guide.metadataSectionText: Embed metadata in your exported images including title, description, author, and copyright information.
guide.safetySectionText: Monitor the scanability of your QR code in real-time. The safety analyzer checks contrast ratio, quiet zone adequacy, and pattern integrity. Lock critical patterns to prevent overlay from affecting scanability.

about.title: About ANQR
about.subtitle: Learn more about ANQR and its features
about.whatIsAnqrText: ANQR is a powerful, browser-based QR code generator that combines simplicity with advanced customization options. Create beautiful, scanable QR codes with custom colors, styles, image overlays, and animations.
about.feature1: Multiple content types: URLs, text, WiFi, contacts, events, and more
about.feature2: Advanced image overlay with dithering algorithms
about.feature3: Custom colors, gradients, and module shapes
about.feature6: Privacy-focused: all processing happens in your browser
about.feature8: Export to PNG, SVG, GIF, and WebP
about.privacyText: ANQR runs entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device. We don't track what QR codes you create or store any of your content.
about.openSourceText: ANQR is built with modern web technologies including React, TypeScript, and Vite. The QR encoding is based on established open-source libraries.
about.supportText: If you find ANQR useful, please consider sharing it with others. For bug reports and feature requests, please contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data
privacy.intro: ANQR is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data.
privacy.dataCollectionText: ANQR processes all data locally in your browser. We do not collect, store, or transmit any of the content you use to create QR codes. Your URLs, text, contact information, and images stay on your device.
privacy.localStorageText: We use browser local storage to save your preferences such as dark mode setting and language preference. This data never leaves your device.
privacy.analyticsText: We may use basic analytics to understand how ANQR is used in aggregate. This does not include any personal information or QR code content.
privacy.advertisingText: ANQR displays ads to support free access to the service. Our advertising partners may use cookies to serve relevant ads. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.thirdPartyText: ANQR may include links to external services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these services.
privacy.changesText: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us through the Contact page.

terms.subtitle: Terms and conditions for using ANQR
terms.acceptanceText: By accessing and using ANQR, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the service.
terms.serviceDescriptionText: ANQR is a free, browser-based QR code generator. The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind.
terms.userResponsibilitiesText: You are responsible for the content you encode in QR codes. Do not use ANQR for illegal purposes, malicious links, or content that violates the rights of others.

terms.disclaimerText: ANQR is provided without warranty. We do not guarantee that QR codes will scan correctly on all devices or that the service will be available at all times.
